name: Kawaisou e Youkoso!
source:
By an accident, I happened to shack up with 2 young sisters in an old apartment. How it's gonna be?
A knock-about erotic adventure novel.



[From [url=http://milksoht0.x0.com/game3.htm]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
阴差阳错之下，我竟在一间老公寓里跟一对年轻姐妹住到了一起。往后的日子会变成什么样呢？

一部热热闹闹的成人冒险小说。
